body:
Delivery time has two parts: how long we take to process your order, and how long the carrier takes to deliver it. Understanding both helps you plan, especially if you need a product by a certain date. This guide explains our processing time, the carrier transit estimates published in our [shipping policy](/shipping/), why times vary across the country, what can add days, how to plan around them, what to do if a parcel is late and what our shipping area covers. It is written for adults aged 21 and over, and all estimates are estimates, not guarantees.

## Processing: 24 to 72 business hours
All orders have a processing time of 24 to 72 business hours, and most ship within 48 hours. The clock starts once your payment is confirmed, not when you place the order, so paying promptly matters. Business days are Monday to Friday. We do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays, and your order continues processing the following business day. Orders may also be reviewed to ensure security and accuracy, and if yours is under review we will contact you the same day.

### What happens during processing
Your order is checked against the products and options you selected, picked from our Stock Warehouse in Phoenix, Arizona, packed in standard discreet packaging, labelled for adult signature delivery and handed to the carrier. A tracking email is then sent automatically. You do not need to do anything during processing, but you can follow the status on your private order page. See [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## Carrier transit
After processing, a tracking email is sent automatically to confirm the package is in the final stages of fulfillment. Carrier delivery times vary by region. Our published estimates are:

- **West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho):** 3 to 7 business days in transit.
- **Eastern half of the US:** 11 to 18 business days in transit.

Those ranges are in business days, Monday to Friday, so a parcel that ships on a Wednesday and has a 3 to 7 business-day estimate would typically arrive between the following Monday and the Monday after.

## Why times vary
We use regional carriers rather than one national network, so speed depends on where you live and on how your parcel is routed. A parcel to Arizona or a neighboring state moves quickly. A parcel to the east passes through more hand-offs and takes longer. Weather, holidays, high-volume periods and adult-signature attempts can add days. Errors and delays caused by regional carriers are outside our control, but we will help you follow up. Read [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## Adding it up: a timeline
Here is a realistic picture for two customers who order on a Monday and pay the same day.

### A customer in Nevada
Payment is confirmed on Monday. Processing takes 24 to 72 business hours, so the parcel ships between Tuesday and Thursday, most likely by Wednesday. Transit takes 3 to 7 business days, so delivery falls between the following Monday and the Monday after that. In total, roughly one to two weeks from ordering.

### A customer in New York
Payment is confirmed on Monday, and the parcel ships by Wednesday. Transit takes 11 to 18 business days, so delivery falls roughly in the third to fifth week after ordering. If you are in the east, plan well ahead and do not leave it until you are running low.

## Signature attempts and delays
Delivery requires an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show photo ID. If no one is available, the carrier typically leaves a notice and tries again, which can add a day or more. If the parcel is returned because no one was available to sign, we process a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost. Choose an address where an adult is usually present, and watch your tracking email. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Planning tips
- **Order early** if you want a product by a certain date, especially in the eastern half of the country.
- **Pay promptly,** because processing starts when payment is confirmed.
- **Use an address where an adult is usually present,** such as a workplace if allowed.
- **Keep your phone number current,** so the carrier can reach you.
- **Watch the tracking email** for the carrier and tracking number.
- **Allow for holidays,** because processing and carrier schedules slow down around them.

## Tracking after it ships
Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created, so do not worry if it shows little at first. Use the carrier's website with the tracking number from your email, and your private order page for our own status. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## If your package is late
First, check the tracking and compare the date with the estimate for your region. If the time exceeds the range, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID. We will help you follow up with the carrier. Our shipping policy describes how lost, stolen and damaged shipments are handled, including package protection where it applies, and the guides on [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/) and [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/) explain the steps.

## Where we ship
We ship within the United States, and free shipping is valid for most of the 48 contiguous states. We do not ship to Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, Hawaii, Alaska or APO, DPO and FPO military addresses with free shipping, and we do not offer international shipping. Orders placed with international shipping will be cancelled and refunded. See [where we ship and where we do not](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Does paying with crypto speed up delivery?
Crypto on most networks is matched automatically, so your payment can be confirmed outside business hours, which starts processing sooner. Delivery time after shipping depends on the carrier.

### Does free shipping take longer?
No. Free and paid shipping use the same processing time and carriers.

### Can I pay for faster shipping?
Our published estimates apply to every order. If timing is critical, contact us before you order and we will advise what is realistic.

### What if I need a delivery date?
We cannot guarantee dates, because carrier times vary. Use the ranges as a guide, and order early.

## Related reading
See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) for the full journey, [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/) for costs and [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) for returns. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## How to read delivery estimates sensibly
Estimates are ranges because real journeys vary. The lower end is what happens when everything goes smoothly: the parcel is scanned quickly, takes a direct route and is delivered on the first attempt. The higher end allows for slower routing, weather and a missed signature. Plan around the higher end if the date matters, and treat the lower end as a pleasant bonus. If you are ordering for a particular day, add a few business days of buffer beyond the upper estimate.

### Holidays and busy periods
Around federal holidays and during busy shopping periods, processing and carrier networks both slow down. Orders placed just before a long weekend start processing on the next business day, and carriers may run reduced schedules. If you are ordering around a holiday, expect the upper end of every range and place your order earlier than you normally would.

### What you can control
You cannot change how fast a carrier moves a parcel, but you can control four things: paying promptly so processing starts sooner, choosing an address where an adult can sign on the first attempt, keeping your phone reachable and acting quickly on delivery notices. Together these remove most avoidable delays, and they cost nothing.

### If your region sits between the two ranges
The published ranges cover the West Coast and the eastern half of the country. If you live in between, expect a time between the two estimates, nearer the lower end if you are close to Arizona and nearer the upper end if you are closer to the east. If you need a firmer idea, contact us with your state and we will tell you what customers there typically see.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Do you ship from the same place every time?** Yes. Orders ship from our Stock Warehouse at 4908 E McDowell Road, Phoenix, Arizona. That is why the West Coast sees the shortest transit times and the east the longest.

**Will I get an email when my order leaves?** Yes. After processing, a tracking email is sent automatically with the carrier and tracking number.

**Does the estimate include the processing time?** No. The 3 to 7 and 11 to 18 business-day ranges are carrier transit time after the order ships. Add 24 to 72 business hours of processing before that.

**What if I order on a Friday?** If your payment is confirmed on a Friday, processing starts that day or the next business day, and weekends are not counted. Your order is likely to ship early in the following week.
